name: Quackdown
summary:
Use close-range blasters, long-range rifles, or even explosive launchers. each kill earns you Quacks, the in-game currency. Spend them to unlock new and better weapons. But watch out: if you get taken down, your weapon might break.

Matches support up to 10 players online, with everyone fighting to get the highest kill count. The more you play, the more gear you can earn. Customize your duck with hats, and more to stand out from the rest.

More maps, weapons, and game modes are coming, so every match stays
